#define set_mem(a, b) memset(a, b, sizeof(a))
#define first_elem first
#define second_elem second
 
typedef long long ll;
 
typedef int flow_type;
typedef int cost_type;
const flow_type INF=1e9;
struct MinCostFlow{
	int node_count;
	vector<cost_type> priority, potential; vector<flow_type> current_flow; vector<int> prev_edge, prev_node;
	priority_queue<pair<cost_type, int>, vector<pair<cost_type, int>>, greater<pair<cost_type, int>>> pq;
	struct edge{int to, rev; flow_type flow, capacity; cost_type cost;};
	vector<vector<edge>> graph;
	MinCostFlow(int n):node_count(n), priority(n), current_flow(n), prev_edge(n), prev_node(n), potential(n), graph(n){}
	void add_edge(int s, int t, flow_type cap, cost_type cst) {
		graph[s].push_back((edge){t, size_of(graph[t]), 0, cap, cst});
		graph[t].push_back((edge){s, size_of(graph[s])-1, 0, 0, -cst});
	}
	pair<flow_type, cost_type> compute_flow(int s, int t) {
		flow_type total_flow=0; cost_type total_cost=0;
		while(true){
			pq.push({0, s});
			fill(all_elements(priority),INF); 
			priority[s]=0; current_flow[s]=INF;
			while(!pq.empty()) {
				auto current=pq.top();
				cost_type dist=current.first_elem;
				int u=current.second_elem;
				pq.pop();
				if(dist!=priority[u]) continue;
				for(int i=0; i<size_of(graph[u]); ++i) {
					edge &e=graph[u][i];
					int v=e.to;
					if(e.capacity<=e.flow) continue;
					cost_type new_priority=priority[u]+e.cost+potential[u]-potential[v];
					if(priority[v]>new_priority) {
						priority[v]=new_priority;
						pq.push({new_priority, v});
						prev_node[v]=u; prev_edge[v]=i;
						current_flow[v]=min(current_flow[u], e.capacity-e.flow);
					}
				}
			}
			if(priority[t]==INF) break;
			for_range(i,0,node_count) potential[i]+=priority[i];
			flow_type delta=min(current_flow[t], INF-total_flow);
			total_flow+=delta;
			for(int v=t; v!=s; v=prev_node[v]) {
				edge &e=graph[prev_node[v]][prev_edge[v]];
				e.flow+=delta; graph[v][e.rev].flow-=delta;
				total_cost+=delta*e.cost;
			}
		}
		return {total_flow,total_cost};
	}
};

int T=150;

int main() {
  int n, m, k, c, d; cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;
  int N = n*T;
  MinCostFlow mcf(N + 2);
  for_range(i, 0, n) for_range(j, 0, T - 1) {
    mcf.add_edge(i * T + j, i * T + j + 1, INF, c);
  }
  for_range(i, 0, T) mcf.add_edge(i, N + 1, INF, 0);
  for_range(i, 0, k) {
    int x; cin >> x; x--;
    mcf.add_edge(N, x * T, 1, 0);

  for_range(i, 0, m) {
    int x, y; cin >> x >> y; x--, y--;

      int cur=1;
      for_range(_, 0, k) {
        mcf.add_edge(x * T + j, y * T + j + 1, 1, cur * d + c);
        mcf.add_edge(y * T + j, x * T + j + 1, 1, cur * d + c);
        cur+=2;
      }
    }
  }
